metadata.scenario: A customer calls to schedule a follow-up consultation with an orthopedic specialist. Category: Appointment Scheduling. Outcome: appointment_booked.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, my name is David Anderson. I was referred by Dorothy Henderson. I need to schedule care for my wife. Hi David! It’s great to hear from you. Can you tell me a bit more about what services your wife needs? Sure, she’s recovering from a stroke and I’m looking for both physical therapy and nursing care to help her with her recovery. Absolutely, we can assist with that. I’ll need to schedule an initial consultation for both services. That sounds good. What does that entail? The consultation will involve assessing her needs and developing a tailored care plan. It usually lasts about an hour. Great, when can we schedule this? Let’s see, we have availability this week. How does Thursday at 10 AM sound? That works for me. Perfect! I’ll set that up for you. Can I have your wife’s full name and any specific concerns you have? Her name is Susan Anderson. I’m particularly concerned about her mobility and the best exercises for her. Thank you, David. I’ll make a note of that for our therapist. Is there anything else I need to know before the appointment? Just be sure to have a list of her current medications and any recent medical records available. That will help us tailor her care effectively. Got it. Also, what is the cost for the physical therapy and nursing services? Physical therapy is priced between $110 and $140 per session, while skilled nursing care is $95 to $125 per visit. Okay, that sounds reasonable. Great! I’ll finalize your appointment for Thursday at 10 AM and send you a confirmation via email. Thank you, Margaret. What’s your email address? You can reach me at mgthompson@carefirsthomehealth.com. Perfect, I’ll send over the medication list after our call. That would be very helpful, thank you! Also, could we possibly arrange companion care for her after the therapy sessions? Yes, we can definitely arrange for companion care. I’ll have our Care Coordinator, Lisa, follow up with you about that. Sounds good, I appreciate the help. No problem at all, David. We’re here to support you and Susan. Thank you, Margaret. I look forward to the appointment. You’re welcome! Have a great day, David. You too, bye! Goodbye!
